segments.name: biopharmaceutical
segments.description: Develops small-molecule and antibody therapies for cancer and inflammatory and autoimmune diseases, with partners, and has no approved products.
segments.evidence: We operate and manage our business as one reportable and operating segment, which is the business of developing and commercializing highly differentiated therapies that have a meaningful impact on patients.

revenueModel.text: Strategic partners pay Arcus upfront and milestone payments, research and development support and clinical materials reimbursement rather than paying for products.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenues to date have been primarily from upfront and milestone payments, R&D support and clinical materials reimbursement from our strategic partners.
